 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER Kedar Prasad Rajak vs The State Of Bihar on 12 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22020918/
1 2 12-03-2024
Heard the parties.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.13555 of 2024(2) dt.12-03-2024 2.

The petitioners are accused in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 67 of 2022 for the offence registered under sections 341, 323, 307, 498A, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and 3/4 of D.P. Act lodged on 11.11.2022 by the informant, Khusboo Kumari.

3. Issue notice to the opposite party no. 2 through both processes i.e. ordinary as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within a period of two weeks from today failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
4.

In case, the order passed is not complied and the matter accordingly stands dismissed,
subsequently, the same be posted under the heading 'To be Mentioned' alongwith 'Tied Up' matters before the Bench on the 'TIED UP' day.

5. List this case after six weeks.
6.
In the meantime, no coercive step shall be taken against the petitioners in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 67 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned SDJM, Lakhisarai.

(Rajiv Roy, J) kiran/-
